mfa_enforcement_status.title: MFA Enforcement Status
mfa_enforcement_status.description: Whether MFA is enforced (required/mandatory), optional, or disabled for authentication across the organization

mfa_enrolled_user_percentage.title: MFA Enrolled User Percentage
mfa_enrolled_user_percentage.description: Percentage of active/in-scope user accounts that have completed MFA enrollment with at least one factor registered (0-100)

privileged_accounts_mfa_enforced.title: MFA Enforced on Privileged Accounts
privileged_accounts_mfa_enforced.description: Whether MFA is mandatorily enforced for all privileged and administrative accounts (e.g., domain admins, cloud IAM admins, root accounts) with no bypass or exception pathways

mfa_bypass_mechanisms_present.title: MFA Bypass Mechanisms Present
mfa_bypass_mechanisms_present.description: Whether known MFA bypass paths exist, such as legacy authentication protocols (IMAP, POP3, SMTP, basic auth, NTLM) that skip MFA, trusted IP/network exclusions, remembered device policies without expiry, or admin-level exclusions

strongest_enrolled_factor_type.title: Strongest Enrolled Factor Type
strongest_enrolled_factor_type.description: The highest-assurance authentication factor type currently enrolled and enforced for users, reflecting the ceiling of identity assurance the MFA configuration can provide

phishing_resistant_factor_required.title: Phishing-Resistant Factor Required
phishing_resistant_factor_required.description: Indicates whether at least one phishing-resistant factor (FIDO2/WebAuthn hardware token or platform biometric bound to origin) is required as part of MFA, preventing credential relay and real-time phishing attacks

auth_event_logging_enabled.title: Authentication Event Logging Enabled
auth_event_logging_enabled.description: Whether the system is configured to generate logs for authentication events including MFA attempts

logged_event_fields.title: Logged Authentication Event Fields
logged_event_fields.description: The set of data fields captured in each authentication event log entry (e.g., factor_type, success_failure_status, timestamp, source_ip, device_fingerprint)

anomalous_login_detection_enabled.title: Anomalous Login Detection Enabled
anomalous_login_detection_enabled.description: Whether the MFA system or identity provider has anomalous login detection actively enabled, including detection of out-of-region logins, impossible travel, and simultaneous sessions

detection_signal_coverage.title: Detection Signal Coverage
detection_signal_coverage.description: List of anomalous login signal types currently enabled for detection (e.g., out_of_region, impossible_travel, rapid_factor_retry, simultaneous_sessions, new_device, tor_or_vpn_exit)

automated_response_action.title: Automated Response Action on Detection
automated_response_action.description: The automated action taken when an anomalous login is detected

privileged_mfa_factor_strength.title: MFA Factor Strength for Privileged Accounts
privileged_mfa_factor_strength.description: The strongest MFA factor type required for privileged account authentication, reflecting resistance to phishing, SIM-swap, and credential relay attacks

privileged_account_mfa_coverage_percent.title: Privileged Account MFA Enrollment Coverage (%)
privileged_account_mfa_coverage_percent.description: Percentage of identified privileged and administrative accounts that have MFA actively enrolled and enforced

privileged_mfa_bypass_paths_exist.title: Privileged MFA Bypass Paths Exist
privileged_mfa_bypass_paths_exist.description: Whether any documented or discoverable bypass paths exist for MFA on privileged accounts, such as break-glass accounts without MFA, legacy authentication protocols enabled for admin accounts, or conditional access exclusion groups containing privileged users

legacy_protocol_auth_disabled.title: Legacy Protocol Authentication Disabled
legacy_protocol_auth_disabled.description: Indicates whether legacy authentication protocols (e.g., Basic Auth, NTLM, IMAP/POP3 with password) that bypass MFA are blocked or disabled

insecure_recovery_paths_disabled.title: Insecure MFA Recovery Paths Disabled
insecure_recovery_paths_disabled.description: Indicates whether insecure fallback recovery mechanisms (e.g., SMS-only account recovery, security question bypass, help-desk override without verification) that allow MFA circumvention are disabled

trusted_device_exceptions_restricted.title: Trusted Device MFA Exceptions Restricted
trusted_device_exceptions_restricted.description: Indicates whether remember-this-device or persistent trusted device exceptions that skip MFA for extended or indefinite periods are disabled or tightly restricted with short expiry

mfa_integrated_systems.title: MFA-Integrated Systems
mfa_integrated_systems.description: List of system types where MFA is enforced at the authentication layer (e.g., sso, vpn, cloud_services, on_premises_apps, admin_consoles)

unprotected_authentication_entry_points.title: Unprotected Authentication Entry Points
unprotected_authentication_entry_points.description: Number of authentication entry points (login endpoints, services, or applications) that are not covered by MFA enforcement

mfa_bypass_paths_exist.title: MFA Bypass Paths Exist
mfa_bypass_paths_exist.description: Whether any documented or discovered bypass mechanisms exist that allow authentication without completing MFA (e.g., legacy protocol fallback, IP-based exclusions, break-glass without MFA) — scoped to integration coverage assessment

failed_mfa_lockout_enabled.title: Failed MFA Lockout Enabled
failed_mfa_lockout_enabled.description: Whether the system automatically locks or temporarily disables an account after a configured number of failed second-factor authentication attempts

failed_mfa_attempt_threshold.title: Failed MFA Attempt Threshold
failed_mfa_attempt_threshold.description: The maximum number of consecutive failed second-factor attempts allowed before an automated response is triggered

automated_response_actions.title: Automated Response Actions on Failed MFA
automated_response_actions.description: List of automated response actions configured to trigger on repeated failed second-factor attempts (e.g., account_lockout, alert_admin, session_termination, rate_limiting)

phishing_resistant_factor_types.title: Phishing-Resistant Factor Types Deployed
phishing_resistant_factor_types.description: List of phishing-resistant authentication factor types currently deployed and available to users (e.g., FIDO2, WebAuthn, hardware_security_key, passkey)

phishing_resistant_factor_enrollment_per.title: User Enrollment Percentage for Phishing-Resistant Factors
phishing_resistant_factor_enrollment_per.description: Percentage of in-scope user accounts that have enrolled at least one phishing-resistant factor

phishing_resistant_factor_enforcement_sc.title: Enforcement Scope for Phishing-Resistant Factors
phishing_resistant_factor_enforcement_sc.description: Defines whether phishing-resistant MFA is enforced (required, not just available) and for which user population

fallback_to_phishable_factor_permitted.title: Fallback to Phishable Factor Permitted
fallback_to_phishable_factor_permitted.description: Indicates whether the authentication policy allows users to fall back to phishable factors (e.g., SMS OTP, email OTP, TOTP) when a phishing-resistant factor is unavailable

self_service_enrollment_available.title: Self-Service MFA Enrollment Available
self_service_enrollment_available.description: Indicates whether users can enroll MFA devices and methods without requiring help desk intervention

user_friction_level.title: MFA User Friction Level
user_friction_level.description: Assessed level of friction imposed on users by the MFA implementation, influencing likelihood of workaround adoption

mfa_bypass_workarounds_detected.title: MFA Bypass Workarounds Detected
mfa_bypass_workarounds_detected.description: Indicates whether shadow IT or informal workarounds (e.g., shared accounts, persistent sessions, application-specific passwords without MFA) have been identified in use to circumvent MFA prompts
